description: harmonization-tool 统筹已登记的独立方法和可复用流程。支持：站点协变量校正；原项目多站点校正：none；原项目多站点校正：combat；原项目多站点校正：combat-gam；原项目多站点校正：covbat。

method_refs.label: 站点协变量校正
method_refs.role: Run the original harmonization dispatcher in fixed site-covar mode on a subject-by-feature NPY matrix and row-aligned metadata containing batch and protected covariates. Retain harmonized features, metadata, site-effect reports and a manifest. Use the original implementation and its declared statistical assumptions。 Inputs: features: NPY 特征矩阵 (file); meta: 样本协变量 CSV (file). Registered outputs: results/harmonized_features.npy, results/manifest.json. Fixed invocation options: --method site-covar.

method_refs.label: 原项目多站点校正：none
method_refs.role: Run the original harmonization dispatcher in fixed none mode on a subject-by-feature NPY matrix and row-aligned metadata containing batch and protected covariates. Retain harmonized features, metadata, site-effect reports and a manifest. The none mode is an uncorrected baseline。 Inputs: features: NPY 特征矩阵 (file); meta: 样本协变量 CSV (file). Registered outputs: results/harmonized_features.npy, results/manifest.json. Fixed invocation options: --method none.

selection_rules: 按需要处理均值/方差、非线性协变量或协方差差异选择 ComBat、ComBat-GAM 或 CovBat，不能只凭年龄跨度自动决定。
name: harmonization-tool
limitations: 站点与研究目标高度混杂、测试站点未见或站点样本不足时，需要评估校正是否可识别以及是否移除了目标效应。
